description: agent-safety-guards hooks. (1) credential_paste_advisory (UserPromptSubmit): when a prompt contains a credential-shaped string, gives Claude a fixed reminder as additionalContext; never blocks, never echoes the value. (2) test_scope_guard: PostToolUse(Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit) records edited file paths per session (async); PreToolUse(Bash|PowerShell) reacts to a command that runs a WHOLE test suite per TEST_SCOPE_GUARD or the test_scope_guard option: advise (default) attaches guidance, enforce denies, off disables. FULL_SUITE=1 as an env prefix of the test command passes. Fails open. See docs/decisions.md D-001 to D-004.

hooks.command: s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/credential_paste_advisory.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s"; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0

s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/test_scope_guard.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s" check; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0

s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/test_scope_guard.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s" track; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0
